items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: things Mercer told me on “Piano Jazz,”

ctx.x: So in that case the movie might not be that strong. The book, usually the book is much better than the movie.

Oh I think they’ll sensationalize that side of him in the movie too. I’m being, I’m probably being cynical, but I think so. It’s funny. A book I liked was the one that Mercer [Ellington] wrote about his father. Did you ever see that book?
